scene: The tile clicks, unlocking three bizarre transit gates along the sidewalk curb.
picture: Side-scrolling view along the brick sidewalk. On the far left, an open pneumatic tube pod waits inside a brass pipe. Centre left, the Pacific Islander girl stands holding the glowing geometric tile, sketchbook underarm. In the centre, a tethered, shimmering bubble platform bobs. On the right, a brass revolving door lift stands open.
shown: a sleek glass pneumatic tube pod sitting open on the far left
a floating, translucent giant soap bubble platform anchored in the centre
a brass revolving door lift standing ready on the right
